name: manifest-device-counter-mismatch
description: A capture segment carrying a different device_counter than the manifest.
asserts: device_counter positions a bundle in the device's monotonic sequence and is what replay and quarantine rules key on. A segment from another position must not ride on this bundle's counter. The manifest signature, content root and member digests are all valid: a valid signature binds the manifest to the device, not the manifest to its segments.
